title: Muryar da Take Kira Zuwa Ga Adalci
intro: A cikin tsohuwar ƙasar Midiya, inda ciniki ya bunƙasa kuma ayarin mutane ke tafiya ta cikin hamada mai faɗi, wani annabin Allah ya tashi a cikin mutanen da suka kauce daga hanyar adalci. An aiko wannan bawan Allah da wani aiki na allahntaka wanda zai gwada imanin al'umma gaba ɗaya. Ta hanyar gwaje-gwajen haƙuri da juriya, wannan rai ta tsaya tsayin daka wajen isar da gargaɗi wanda zai yi ta yawo a cikin tarihi. Za ku iya warware asirin wannan manzon da ya daɗe?
clues: Allah ne ya zaɓe ni don in shiryar da mutanen da suka manta da ƙa'idodin adalci da gaskiya a cikin mu'amalarsu.
Na isar da saƙo ina kira ga al'ummata da ta bauta wa Allah sai Allah kuma ta yi magana da gaskiya a cikin dukkan al'amura.
Na yi gargaɗi musamman game da cin dukiya ta hanyar haramtacciyar hanya, kuma na jaddada muhimmancin ma'auni da aunawa daidai.
Mutanena sun amsa gargaɗina da izgili, suna barazanar korar ni daga ƙasarsu idan na ci gaba da saƙona.
Na ci gaba da jajircewa a kan manufar da na sa a gaba duk da adawarsu, ina mai bayyana cewa ladana yana ga Allah shi kaɗai.
An kama mutanena da wata mummunar azaba yayin da aka cece ni da rahamar Ubangijina, yayin da aka cika mini manufata.

trial.label: Gwaji/Taron
options: Fuskantar mutanen da suka ƙi gaskiya kuma suka yi barazanar azabtarwa saboda isar da saƙon Allah
Shaida Babban Ruwan Tsufa wanda ya halaka kafiran wata al'umma
Karɓar wahayi yayin tafiya ta kwarin 笃
Jarabawar imani lokacin da wani mai mulki mai zalunci ya yi ƙoƙarin dakatar da kiran zuwa ga tauhidi
Wata al'umma tana neman ruwan sama a lokacin fari mai tsanani bayan shekaru da yawa na rashin biyayya
trial.answer: Fuskantar mutanen da suka ƙi gaskiya kuma suka yi barazanar azabtarwa saboda isar da saƙon Allah

location.label: Babban Sinadari
options: Ƙasar Madayana, inda mutanena ke gudanar da harkokinsu da kasuwancinsu
Tekun wani babban jirgin ruwa da ya ceci muminai daga ambaliyar ruwa mai tsanani
Kogo a cikin wani dutse mai duwatsu inda matasa bakwai suka nemi mafaka daga tsanantawa
Birnin Kudus mai tsarki inda aka kai ni tafiya ta dare ɗaya
Fadar Sheba inda wata babbar masarauta ta shirya don shaida wata alama ta allahntaka
location.answer: Ƙasar Madayana, inda mutanena ke gudanar da harkokinsu da kasuwancinsu

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An kama mutanena da mummunan azaba yayin da nake tsira, domin na cika wajibina ga Allah
An mayar da kafirai birrai saboda sun keta iyakokin Allah masu tsarki
Maƙiyana sun rungumi imani bayan sun ga canji mai ban mamaki
An albarkaci ƙasar da ruwan sama mai yawa da wadata bayan mutanen sun tuba
Jama'ata sun yi min shahada saboda kin yin watsi da aikina
outcome.answer: An kama mutanena da mummunan azaba yayin da nake tsira, domin na cika wajibina ga Allah

arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
